movie_title: Do our pets care about us? - 6 Minute English
introduction: Improve your English vocabulary and listening in just six minutes! We love and care for our pets. Bu

vocabulary.definition: to give animals human qualities and characteristics
vocabulary.example: Many pet owners anthropomorphize their pets by talking to them as if they can understand.

vocabulary.definition: to pretend to be affected by (a feeling, state, or injury)
vocabulary.example: She decided to feign interest in the conversation even though she was bored.

vocabulary.definition: feelings of worry, sadness, or pain
vocabulary.example: The news of the accident caused her great distress.
The athlete was in agony after injuring his knee during the game.

vocabulary.definition: describing animals that are not wild and live under human control
vocabulary.example: Dogs and cats are common domesticated animals that live as pets in many households.

vocabulary.definition: how some animals clean themselves using their tongue and paws
vocabulary.example: The cat spent hours grooming itself, making sure its fur was clean and shiny.
